card.name: Cross-reference and figure-label openers
card.fires_on: Words that open a label or reference: the end of "Precautions" or "Pharmacology" inside a bracketed [see ...] pointer, and "Figure" starting a caption after a sentence. Also a few news-release openers like "advance" or "Related".

modes.label: Section pointer endings
modes.description: The last piece of "Precautions" or "Pharmacology" in a bracketed [see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)] cross-reference.

modes.label: Figure caption start
modes.description: The word "Figure" beginning a caption right after a sentence that cites a figure.

modes.label: News release openers
modes.description: A word in press-release text that introduces a dated edition or related item.
modes.example: In the September 12<< advance>> online edition of Nature

card.plain: It fires on the words that introduce a cross-reference or a figure caption in a drug label or article.
